spine: 1. Chrome 縱深防禦有兩道邊界：OS process sandbox 關住 renderer，V8 heap sandbox 是 in-process 的第二層，其設計假設是『就算 renderer 淪陷、攻擊者能任意讀寫沙箱記憶體，破壞半徑仍停在 1 TB 邊界內』。
2. 沙箱是一個 1 TB region：開頭 4 GB pointer compression cage 裝所有 V8 heap，之後接 ArrayBuffer 與 Wasm backing store；靠指標壓縮成偏移量、越界被夾回區內來維持隔離。
3. bug：FrameStateFunctionInfo 的相等運算子只比 base class 欄位，沒比 JSToWasmFrameStateFunctionInfo 多出來的 Wasm signature，讓兩個回傳型別不同的 JS-to-Wasm continuation FrameState 被 optimizer 判為等價。
4. deoptimizer 對 kI64 與 reference 回傳讀同一顆 kReturnRegister0，只差解讀方式（cast int64_t box BigInt vs wrap Tagged<Object>）；型別混淆就地生出 addrof 與 fakeobj，100% 成功率、不需 spray。
5. fakeobj + 合法 map/properties 通過 layout check → in-object property store 寫到 i64 指的位址；材料化出的 reference 就算指標在沙箱外仍能正常 dereference，攻擊者於是偽造沙箱外物件指標。
6. 一個 tagged SMI 寫入即可塞 short relative jump、導入 shellcode，在 renderer 達成 RCE；單一 bug 走完 renderer 淪陷與沙箱逃逸兩道邊界，推翻沙箱核心假設。

perspective.mechanism: 一個 compiler 相等運算子的欄位遺漏，如何把 deopt metadata 變成型別混淆源、再讓混淆材料化出的 reference 繞過 in-process sandbox 的指標夾限，用單一 bug 連穿兩道安全邊界。
perspective.tradeoff: V8 heap sandbox 是 in-process software isolation：便宜、每次存取額外成本低，但完整性完全建立在『沒有任何路徑能生出繞過壓縮/夾限的指標』這個前提；deopt 材料化就是那條旁路，於是低成本隔離換來的是『邊界可被編譯器內部路徑旁路』的風險。
perspective.reader_use: 維護 in-process isolation（V8 sandbox 類）的工程師：審計重心不能只放在邊界檢查本身，還要涵蓋所有能生出 reference 的編譯器路徑（deopt / inlining / continuation）；相等運算子少比一欄從 miscompile 正確性 bug 升級為沙箱逃逸路徑。一般 Chrome 使用者：升級到 147.0.7727.101 以上。

notes.quote: Longinus: 2 Boundaries in One Bug, Piercing Chrome's Renderer and V8 Sandbox with a Single Vulnerability, CVE-2026-6307
notes.interpretation: CVE 編號與命名；賣點是同一顆漏洞連穿 renderer 與 V8 sandbox 兩道邊界。

notes.quote: The bug was introduced in Chrome 106, can affect 148 beta at the time of report, and fixed in Chrome 147.0.7727.101. Any released Chrome version between 106 and 147 is affected.
notes.interpretation: 存活範圍：106 引入、147.0.7727.101 修補、106 到 147 之間正式版皆受影響、回報時 148 beta 亦在射程；橫跨約 4 年。

notes.quote: V8 Heap Sandbox is an in-process software fault isolation, that confines memory corruption bugs originating from untrusted JavaScript or WebAssembly code
notes.interpretation: V8 heap sandbox 的定位：in-process 軟體隔離，用來把來自不受信任 JS/Wasm 的記憶體破壞關住。

notes.quote: an attacker can arbitrarily and concurrently read and write memory in the V8 heap sandbox region with primitives from typical traditional V8 vulnerabilities (addrof and fakeobj).
notes.interpretation: 沙箱的威脅模型前提：把 addrof/fakeobj 帶來的沙箱內任意讀寫視為『已發生但仍被容納』的常態。

notes.quote: The V8 sandbox is currently a 1 TB large region, containing all V8 heaps (located inside the 4GB V8 pointer compression cage at the start of the sandbox), ArrayBuffer backing stores and Wasm backing buffers.
notes.interpretation: 沙箱記憶體形狀：1 TB region，開頭 4 GB pointer compression cage 裝所有 V8 heap，之後接 ArrayBuffer 與 Wasm backing store。原文未逐一點名 JIT code region 的位置；post 已把此推斷明確標為『合理的推測』，不再當事實斷言。

notes.quote: Two JS-to-Wasm continuation FrameState nodes can look equivalent to the graph optimizer even though they describe different Wasm return types.
notes.interpretation: 型別混淆的根：兩個描述不同 Wasm 回傳型別的 JS-to-Wasm continuation FrameState 節點被 graph optimizer 判為等價。

notes.quote: return lhs.type() == rhs.type() && lhs.parameter_count() == rhs.parameter_count() && lhs.max_arguments() == rhs.max_arguments() && lhs.local_count() == rhs.local_count() && lhs.shared_info().equals(rhs.shared_info()) && lhs.bytecode_array().equals(rhs.bytecode_array());
notes.interpretation: 有問題的相等運算子原始碼：逐一比 type/parameter_count/max_arguments/local_count/shared_info/bytecode_array，沒有比 signature。

notes.quote: JSToWasmFrameStateFunctionInfo inherits from FrameStateFunctionInfo and adds the signature_ field described above. However, the equality operator accepted references to the base class and only compared fields from that base class. It never compared the Wasm signatures.
notes.interpretation: root cause：子類多加 signature_ 欄位，但相等運算子收 base class reference、只比 base class 欄位，從未比較 Wasm signature。

notes.quote: This becomes a problem when the same optimized JavaScript function can call two Wasm getters with matching parameter lists but different return types.
notes.interpretation: 觸發條件：同一個被優化的 JS 函式呼叫兩個參數列表相同、回傳型別不同的 Wasm getter。

notes.quote: builder.addFunction('return_ref', kSig_r_v) ... builder.addFunction('return_i64', kSig_l_v)
notes.interpretation: 兩個構造用的 Wasm 函式宣告：return_ref 用 kSig_r_v（回 reference/externref），return_i64 用 kSig_l_v（回 i64）。

notes.quote: The final call invokes the externref getter, but the value is reconstructed as an i64. This exposes the full tagged pointer(64 bits) of target as a i64, giving us an addrof primitive.
notes.interpretation: addrof 成型：externref getter 的回傳被當成 i64 重建，target 的完整 64-bit tagged pointer 以整數流出。

notes.quote: The returned i64 is reconstructed as a tagged reference, allowing an attacker-controlled address to be treated as a JavaScript object.
notes.interpretation: fakeobj 成型：回傳的 i64 被當成 tagged reference 重建，攻擊者控制的位址被當成 JS 物件。

notes.quote: For both kI64 and reference returns, it reads the same machine return register, kReturnRegister0. The only difference is how the bits are interpreted: kI64 casts the register value to an int64_t and boxes it as a BigInt, while kRef and kRefNull wrap the register value as a Tagged<Object>.
notes.interpretation: 混淆的物理根：kI64 與 reference 回傳讀同一顆 kReturnRegister0，差別只在解讀——kI64 cast int64_t 並 box BigInt；kRef/kRefNull wrap Tagged<Object>。

notes.quote: This supplies the addrof and fakeobj primitives
notes.interpretation: deoptimizer 的材料化混淆同時供給 addrof 與 fakeobj 兩個 primitive。

notes.quote: As long as a valid map and properties field are present before the chosen write target, the object passes the required layout checks and the in-object property store reaches the address pointed to by the i64.
notes.interpretation: 任意寫：目標位址前擺合法 map 與 properties，假物件通過 layout check，in-object property store 寫到 i64 指向的位址。

notes.quote: can then be used to patch any nearby instruction
notes.interpretation: in-object property store 可進一步用來 patch 附近的指令。

notes.quote: the newly materialized reference can still be dereferenced normally, even when its underlying pointer lies outside the V8 sandbox.
notes.interpretation: 沙箱逃逸的核心：材料化出的 reference 就算底層指標落在 V8 sandbox 之外，仍能正常 dereference——繞過壓縮/夾限。

notes.quote: what if we can forge an object pointer with a valid map outside of sandbox?
notes.interpretation: 攻擊者提出的關鍵問題：在沙箱外偽造一個帶合法 map 的物件指標。

notes.quote: a tagged SMI write is sufficient to place a short relative jump after one of the staged qwords and redirect execution into smuggled shellcode, allowing RCE in the renderer process.
notes.interpretation: 最後一步：一個 tagged SMI 寫入即可在事先鋪好的 qword 後面塞 short relative jump、把執行流導進 shellcode，在 renderer process 達成 RCE。

notes.quote: Gain arbitrary memory read/write primitive with 100% success rate, without any spraying trick; Achieve V8 heap sandbox escape and RCE on its own, without any other bug; Found in Chrome 106, across 4 years
notes.interpretation: 作者列的三條能力：100% 成功率任意讀寫且不需 spray；單一 bug 完成沙箱逃逸與 RCE、不需其他 bug；Chrome 106 起、橫跨 4 年。

notes.quote: 2026-03-29: We reported the bug to Google. 2026-03-31: Google identified the root cause and finished the fix. 2026-04-07: The fix was released in Chrome 147.0.7727.101. 2026-06-29: We published this blog post.
notes.interpretation: 時間線：3/29 回報、3/31 定位 root cause 並完成修補、4/7 隨 147.0.7727.101 發佈、6/29 公開 write-up。

notes.quote: Nebula Security ... Vega
notes.interpretation: 發現者：Nebula Security，透過其 Vega 工具找到。
